notes.text: New: Add support for PNG avatars
New: Add setting to display ISO date and time in message list
New: Used fixed-width font for composing when user chooses fixed-width for viewing
Changed: Attachment summary moved from message bottom to header for visibility
Fixed: EHLO parsing exception appeared in logcat when sending email
Fixed: "Delete (from notification)" setting did not retain state
Fixed: Find folder search hint text was cut off on smaller screens
Fixed: User was not notified if they were offline when sending message
Fixed: Warned "Sent folder not found" when uploading sent messages was disabled
Fixed: Loading bar appeared detached from header, leaving visible gap
Fixed: CC/BCC fields were not expanded by default for Reply All
